entries.title: Judges 10:1
segments: ¶Now after Abimelech, Tola, the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar, became the saviour of Israel; he was living in Shamir in the hill-country of Ephraim.

entries.title: Judges 10:2
segments: He was judge over Israel for twenty-three years; and at his death his body was put to rest in the earth in Shamir.

entries.title: Judges 10:3
segments: And after him came Jair the Gileadite, who was judge over Israel for twenty-two years.

entries.title: Judges 10:4
segments: And he had thirty sons, who went on thirty young asses; and they had thirty towns in the land of Gilead, which are named Havvoth-Jair to this day.

entries.title: Judges 10:5
segments: And at the death of Jair his body was put to rest in the earth in Kamon.

entries.title: Judges 10:6
segments: ¶And again the children of Israel did evil in the eyes of the Lord, worshipping the Baals and Astartes, and the gods of Aram and the gods of Zidon and the gods of Moab and the gods of the children of Ammon and the gods of the Philistines; they gave up the Lord and were servants to him no longer.

entries.title: Judges 10:7
segments: And the wrath of the Lord was burning against Israel, and he gave them up into the hands of the Philistines and into the hands of the children of Ammon.

entries.title: Judges 10:8
segments: And that year the children of Israel were crushed under their yoke; for eighteen years all the children of Israel on the other side of Jordan, in the land of the Amorites which is in Gilead, were cruelly crushed down.

entries.title: Judges 10:9
segments: And the children of Ammon went over Jordan, to make war against Judah and Benjamin and the house of Ephraim; and Israel was in great trouble.

entries.title: Judges 10:10
segments: ¶Then the children of Israel, crying out to the Lord, said, Great is our sin against you, for we have given up our God and have been servants to the Baals.

entries.title: Judges 10:11
segments: And the Lord said to the children of Israel, Were not the Egyptians and the Amorites and the children of Ammon and the Philistines

entries.title: Judges 10:12
segments: And the Zidonians and Amalek and Midian crushing you down, and in answer to your cry did I not give you salvation from their hands?

entries.title: Judges 10:13
segments: But, for all this, you have given me up and have been servants to other gods: so I will be your saviour no longer.

entries.title: Judges 10:14
segments: Go, send up your cry for help to the gods of your selection; let them be your saviours in the time of your trouble.

entries.title: Judges 10:15
segments: And the children of Israel said to the Lord, We are sinners; do to us whatever seems good to you: only give us salvation this day.

entries.title: Judges 10:16
segments: So they put away the strange gods from among them, and became the Lord's servants; and his soul was angry because of the sorrows of Israel.

entries.title: Judges 10:17
segments: Then the children of Ammon came together and put their army in position in Gilead. And the children of Israel came together and put their army in position in Mizpah.

entries.title: Judges 10:18
segments: And the people of Israel said to one another, Who will be the first to make an attack on the children of Ammon? We will make him head over all Gilead.
